global_rules: Published values are transcribed rounded values, not newly measured scores. Missing values are null or empty lists, never zeros.

A paper score is directly comparable only when task/split/test IDs, solver evidence, metric implementation, failure accounting and aggregation match. Training regime and inference resources are disclosed separately.
